_: Blekkspruten in English: Inky (an octopus who inks the squares of a nonogram). «Blekk» (ink) is the filled square; «Kryss» a cross for a square you know is empty.
This square was wrong – it's been rubbed out. {sted}.
Se på rad {n}: det som må stå der, er fy: Look at row {n}: what has to be there is filled in.
Se på kolonne {n}: det som må stå der, e: Look at column {n}: what has to be there is filled in.
Piltastene flytter, mellomrom fyller, X: Arrow keys move, Space inks, X crosses.
Tallene ved hver rad og over hver kolonn: The numbers beside each row and above each column tell you how long the runs of ink are, in order. Fill in the squares and a picture appears.
«3 1» betyr tre fylte ruter på rad, mins: “3 1” means three inked squares in a row, at least one blank, then one inked square. A 0 means the whole line is blank.
Trykk på en rute for å fylle den med ble: Tap a square to ink it. Choose Cross to mark squares you know are blank. Drag your finger to do lots at once.
Når alle radene og kolonnene stemmer med: When every row and column matches its numbers, the picture is finished. The numbers fade when a line is right.
Begynn med de store tallene: en strek på: Start with the big numbers: a run of 8 in a row of 10 must cover the middle six squares wherever it sits.
Kryssene er bare notater for deg selv, m: Crosses are just notes for you, but they make it much easier to see what's left.
Trykk på en rute med samme merke igjen f: Tap a square with the same mark again to rub it out.
Hvert brett har bare én løsning, og du t: Every grid has only one solution, and you never need to guess. A hint fills in what must be in one line, or shows a square that's wrong.
Dagens nonogram er det samme for alle: l: Today's nonogram is the same for everyone: small on Monday, bigger at the weekend.
Med tastatur: piltastene flytter, mellom: With a keyboard: the arrow keys move, Space or Enter inks, X crosses, Backspace rubs out, H gives a hint and P pauses.
The numbers say where the ink goes.
Follow them, and a picture appears.
Hva bildet forestiller, får du vite når: You'll find out what the picture is when it's finished.
Hvert brett er nytt og har bare én løsni: Every grid is new and has only one solution – you never need to guess.
Hva vil du løse?: What would you like to solve?
Brettet, {r} rader og {k} kolonner. Pilt: The grid, {r} rows and {k} columns. Arrow keys move, Space inks, X crosses.
Tap or drag to ink the squares.
The grid is waiting for you.
Du løste dagens nonogram på {tid} første: You solved today's nonogram in {tid} the first time.
Alle i hele landet får det samme brettet: Everyone in the country gets the same grid today.
Uten hint! Alle i hele landet får det sa: No hints! Everyone in the country gets the same grid today.
Bildet er malt fram – og havnet i samlin: The picture is painted – and it's in your collection now.
Første brett på {str} – nå har du en rek: Your first {str} grid – now you've got a record to beat!
